text:
Marta: Heads up — ByteCloud pilot next week needs 8x A10g reserved in eu-west-1 for a PoC. Partner updated their marketplace SKU last night which broke our reservation mapping. Can procurement/ops advise on capacity and lead-time? reservation id `resv-8231`

inventory-bot: Inventory sync failed for eu-west-1 after marketplace SKU change: error 409 mapping conflict for `resv-8231`
```
error: SKU_ALIAS_CONFLICT
reservation: resv-8231
source: marketplace-sync
```

Leo: On it. Supplier pushed lead-time from 7d -> 21d due to SKU freeze. We have 6 GPUs in transit to eu-west-1 arriving in ~10d. Might be able to reroute some shipments but need ops signoff. cc @Sameer :thinking_face:

Sameer: Short version — we can't cover 8x A10g in eu-west-1 for the pilot window unless we reallocate from internal dev. Options: pull 4 from dev cluster + 4 from dedicated pool (impacts internal CI) OR cross-region fallback. How critical is the Tue demo?

Amy: Pilot is timeboxed. Customer demo Tue 2026-04-06 EOD, need full 8 for a 48h window starting Tue 09:00 UTC. If we miss that, partner stalls. Can we do a region swap to eu-north/westeurope? Here's the marketplace listing they changed: https://marketplace.bytecloud.example/sku/BC-A10G

Leo: eu-north/westeurope currently has 12 A10g free, but extra hop may increase p99 latency ~10-20ms. We can ship 4 from transit to eu-north in ~5 days. For the 48h window we can do a temporary cross-region routing policy — requires product/ops + routing change.

Sameer: We can implement a temporary routing rule: pin partner traffic to eu-north for the 48h window and set an automatic fallback to a smaller model if capacity dips. Need console change: route rule `partner/bytecloud/* -> eu-north` + canary window. Also need the SKU mapping fixed for `resv-8231` so the reservation resolves. @oncall-eng can you approve and patch the mapper?

oncall-eng: Approve the routing change for the pilot window. I'll create the canary and instrument monitoring. Also will patch the marketplace mapper to accept the new SKU alias. ETA ~2h.

Marta: Action list:
1) @Leo — expedite/reroute 4 units to eu-north (RMA/expedite)
2) @Sameer — add routing rule + fallback in Console for partner account for Tue 09:00-Thu 09:00 UTC
3) @oncall-eng — patch marketplace mapper and roll canary, watch alerts
4) @Amy — confirm partner accepts eu-north latency tradeoff, or if they'd prefer demo model scaled to 6 GPUs
I'll update Kevin at ByteCloud and create a quick status doc in #joint-announcements. :white_check_mark:

Amy: Kevin (ByteCloud) is checking with the customer now. He asked whether we can reduce demo model size to fit 6 GPUs if we absolutely must. Will confirm in ~30m.

inventory-bot: Reservation `resv-8231` mapping updated: old SKU -> new SKU alias `BC-A10G-v2`. Sync COMPLETE.

Marta: Great — keep me posted. If the mapping re-breaks, we revert to the canary fallback and delay the external demo until we have confirmed hardware arrival. Thanks everyone! :handshake:
